old-mother-west-wind-way-in.mp3: Old Mother West Wind. Every morning Old Mother West Wind comes down from the Purple Hills with a big bag over her shoulder. In the bag are her children, the Merry Little Breezes. She shakes them out onto the Green Meadows, and the first thing they do is race round to everybody and ask for the news. Grandfather Frog always has some. Listen to the first chapter. It is short. Then find out what the news is in your house.
story-of-doctor-dolittle-way-in.mp3: The Story of Doctor Dolittle. Doctor Dolittle has so many animals in his house that people stop coming to see him. Then one rainy afternoon his parrot, Polynesia, tells him a secret. Animals can talk. Not just parrots. All of them. They just do not always use their mouths, and you only hear it if you watch. The Doctor gets a pencil and starts writing it down. Listen to the chapter where it happens. Then go and watch an animal the way Polynesia taught him.
winnie-the-pooh-way-in.mp3: Winnie-the-Pooh. Winnie-the-Pooh is a bear who lives in a forest. One day he hears a buzzing at the top of a tree, so he sits down and thinks. A buzzing like that must mean something. Then he climbs, and makes up a song on the way, and it all goes wrong in a very funny way. Listen to the first chapter. Then find a sound in your house that keeps going, and work out what it means.
